    S01:E02 - Winners and Losers

    27 min
    TV-G

    Bec draws the rest of the team into debate about Anna's place at the Academy. Feeling pressure to prove she belongs, Anna challenges Joe to a surf-off; if he wins, she'll leave. When Joe picks a dangerous local break for their competition, Bec's forced to choose between loyalty to her brother and fairness to Anna. Despite the treacherous conditions, Anna surfs like a champion. She wins the respect of her teammates, and Bec's grudging approval.

    S01:E04 - Fly Takes a Dive

    27 min
    TV-G

    Fly's homesick and feels like she doesn't fit in. Calling home, she accidentally runs up a huge bill on Anna's mobile. To pay it off without Anna finding out, she secretly starts work at a carwash. Hiding from Deb, Fly breaks the carwash machinery and ends up deeper in debt. She's about to quit when the rest of the team come to her rescue.

    S01:E06 - Edge Wipes Out

    27 min
    TV-G

    Edge is losing surf competitions because take Simmo's advice. He's been told to do less crowd-pleasing aerials, and more judge-pleasing maneuvers. Edge goes kite-boarding in rough seas after only one lesson, because he's sure he's got the talent to handle it. After he crashes and almost drowns, Bec puts her own life at risk to rescue him. Edge is forced to rethink his attitude.

    S01:E08 - Brothers and Sisters

    27 min
    TV-G

    Bec's friendship with her brother Joe has suffered since she made it into the Academy, and he didn't. He's hanging out with a new crowd who are determined to make life difficult for the Solar Blue team. She catches him stealing the Academy's surfboards, and is pressured by the rest of the team to inform the police. But Bec knows that her relationship with her brother could be destroyed if she does.
